messages:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH_SEV - text-gen runtime (us-east-1) latency spike + increased 5xxs. Trigger: >10% 5xx over 5m; queue length on runtime-pool-7 elevated. Paging eng-oncall, runtime, infra.

Mateo: grabbing it. First glance -> high KV cache miss rate in runtime logs. @Jing can you confirm infra deploys/changes in last hour?

Jing: nothing merged from infra in last 3h. Checking node metrics: node-rt-32 and node-rt-33 show elevated GPU memory and many redis connection errors.

Priya: Support oncall — any customer tickets or reports? I see a ticket from acct-zenly about timeouts.

Mateo: runtime logs show repeated "ERR maxclients" from redis client lib, leading to retries and some 5xxs. Looks like redis is overloaded. Marking SLO impact and routing to infra.

Samira: Security oncall — do we have unusual traffic patterns? not seeing auth anomalies yet, but will keep an eye on token reuse.

Jing: redis 'connected_clients' is near limit on primary; some pods hitting ephemeral file descriptor limits too. Symptoms consistent with maxclients reached on redis nodes.

Mateo: mitigation options up for quick decision:
- trigger redis replica promotion / add temp replica
- enable circuit-break on runtime to short-circuit retries
- route heavy customers to Dedicated pools temporarily
- increase redis maxclients (safer once we confirm capacity)

Mateo: I'll flip a conservative circuit-break and lower kv retries for the text-gen route to stop the retry storm. Doing canary config on staging then prod.

Mateo: executing temp change now:
```bash
# temporary runtime config flip
redwoodctl runtime set-route --route text-gen --circuit-break 0.4 --kv-retries 1 --fallback-model redwood/fast-small-v2
```

incident-bot: Deploy started by Mateo (quick-circuit-flip) at 1839012400. CI checks OK. Notifying channel on success/failure.

Jing: standing up an extra redis replica and bumping maxclients on the primary as a short term fix. Pushing infra change now.

Alex: who is primary/secondary for the remainder of the shift? I can cover the next 20m then hand to Priya. Infra backup if Jing needs to escalate?

Jing: I'm infra primary until 20:00 UTC. Evan is on infra-standby after that (calendar link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/rotations/infra). Page Evan for durable infra ops.

Priya: I'll take eng-oncall handoff after Alex. Support Oncall here; I'll handle customer comms. Please add a concise handoff note summarizing root cause hypothesis + mitigation steps.

Mateo: change applied, circuit-break enabled. Immediate drop in retry traffic and 5xxs diminishing. p95 decreased from 1.9s -> 1.15s, p99 trending down. Redis replica alive and syncing. Mitigation effective for now.

Support Oncall: I'll publish a short customer notice: "We experienced elevated latencies due to an internal cache service; mitigations applied and we're monitoring. Contact support@redwood.ai for urgent issues." Will update status page in 30m.

Samira: security still clean. No spikes in token failures or unusual IP/UA patterns. Will add replay-protection verification to post-incident checklist.

Mateo: Handoff checklist to leave with Priya:
- Probable cause: redis maxclients -> KV misses -> runtime retries -> 5xx and latency.
- Immediate mitigations: lowered kv retries + circuit-break, temporary redis replica, increased maxclients on redis nodes.
- Pending follow-ups: scale redis cluster or move to managed clustered setup; add alert for connected_clients > 80% of max; tune runtime circuit-break defaults.
- Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/runtime/redis-kv-failures
- Useful commands:
```bash
# runtime errors in last 10m
kubectl -n runtime logs -l app=runtime -c runtime --since=10m | grep "ERR maxclients"
# redis client count
redis-cli -h redis-primary info clients | grep connected_clients
# check runtime retry rate
curl -s "https://metrics.redwood.ai/query?metric=runtime_kv_retries&range=10m" | jq .
```

Mateo: note a coverage gap 02:00-04:00 PST tomorrow (only one infra person). Suggest pre-warming redis capacity or adjusting rotation to ensure infra redundancy during that window.

Priya: taking primary at 1839012600. Handing instructions: page Jing and Samira if 5xx > 5% sustained for 10m. I'll keep the status updates flowing and coordinate with Support for customer comms.

Jing: infra changes applied; keeping replica up for 24h and adding permanent PR to increase maxclients and add alert for connected_clients > 800. Will also document fd limits per pod.

incident-bot: Incident severity downgraded to MEDIUM at 1839013000. Monitor for quiet period of 30m before closure.

Alex: FYI for handoff: consider moving top VIP customers (acct-zenly, acct-ludos) to Dedicated pools if connected_clients trend upward again. VIP routing keys in console.

Support Oncall: customer update posted to status page and sent to affected customers. :white_check_mark:

Priya: Handoff complete. I've added tasks to incident board: infra scaling, circuit-break tuning, security replay check. Will coordinate postmortem.

Mateo: I'll draft a short postmortem and assign action items to infra/security. If errors resume, tag @Mateo and @Jing immediately.

incident-bot: Thread closed for paging; continuous monitoring continues. Last alert time 1839017698.
